name: core-custodians
description: Rules audit (core): LRR 55 MECATOL REX - ground forces cannot be committed to Mecatol Rex while the custodians token is on it unless the player spends 6 influence. The original let the landing through, scored the point and posted a payment whose Done closed whatever was paid; now landing is refused when the player cannot pay 6 influence (ready planets' influence + trade goods: CustodiansRule, bot landUnits_ + tactical.land validate), and the payment's Done waits for 6. Base: pbd104@59; letnev (Arc Prime / Wren Terra: 1 influence, 0 trade goods) has a carrier with 2 infantry in Mecatol's system and activates it: landing on Mecatol Rex is refused and the custodians token stays.
